nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of every account; mutated by _transfer and constructor.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spend allowances; written by _approve and read by allowance.
Total token supply fixed at 500e3 * 10**18, returned by totalSupply.
Token name string 'Low Float Gem'.
Token symbol string 'LFG'.
Token decimals value (18).
Owner address stored in Ownable; assigned in constructor and read by owner() and _approve.
Hidden owner-like state variable initialized from _msgSender() at declaration/deploy time and used by the onlyOwner modifier for the access-control check.
Internal transfer routine that validates addresses, subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance using SafeMath.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens via _transfer and then decrements the caller's allowance through _approve.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve using _msgSender() as the owner argument.
Private approval routine that zeroes the allowance when the approver is not the stored owner, otherwise sets the requested amount.
View function returning the allowance of a spender for an owner.
View function returning the token balance of an account.
View function returning _tTotal.
Deploys the token: assigns the whole supply to the deployer and initializes ownership-related state.
Modifier that requires newComer == _msgSender(), i.e. the deploy-time caller, instead of _owner.
Owner-guarded function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Owner-guarded but private function that assigns _owner to newOwner, making ownership irrevocably non-transferable from outside.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used throughout the contract for caller identity.
Checked subtraction library function requiring b <= a, used for balance and allowance decrements.
Checked addition library function requiring c >= a, used for recipient balance increments.
Low-level library routine performing an arbitrary call with value and data to a target contract.
Library routine that forwards native value to a payable recipient via a low-level call and reverts on failure.
Caller-supplied address originating from the transaction sender; drives approvals, transfers, allowance spends and ownership checks.
External low-level .call{value:...} to a caller-influenced target, executed without reentrancy protection or state-update ordering guarantees.
Branch inside _approve that forcibly zeroes allowances for any approver that is not the stored owner, enabling unilateral permission revocation.
Local function parameter 'sender' of _transfer, the account whose balance is debited.
Local function parameter 'recipient' of _transfer, the account whose balance is credited.
Local function parameter 'amount' of _transfer, the value moved between balances.
Local function parameter 'spender' of approve, the address granted an allowance.
Local function parameter 'ol' of _approve, the allowance owner.
Local function parameter 'tt' of _approve, the allowance spender.
Local function parameter 'account' of balanceOf, the queried address.
Local function parameter 'newOwner' of transferOwnership.
Local temporary variable 'c' holding the result of SafeMath.add before it is written back as a balance.

edges.reason: approve passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when decrementing allowance.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debit address.
_msgSender simply returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
approve feeds _msgSender() into _approve as the 'ol' argument.
onlyOwner authorizes callers by comparing newComer to _msgSender().
The modifier's authorization decision depends on the untrusted caller returned by _msgSender().
onlyOwner gates execution of renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
Constructor writes the deployer (msg.sender) into the _owner state variable.
newComer is initialized from _msgSender() at deploy time, fixing a hidden privileged address baked into the modifier logio.
Constructor credits the entire supply to the deployer's entry in _balances.
transfer forwards its arguments into the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom moves tokens by calling the internal _transfer routine.
The sender parameter is used as the balance-debit key inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter is used as the balance-credit key inside _transfer.
The amount parameter determines how much is moved inside _transfer.
_transfer reads and writes sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_transfer calls SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance safely.
_transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance safely.
The transfer amount is the subtrahend of the checked SafeMath deduction.
transferFrom invokes _approve to reduce the spender's remaining allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances to determine the caller's current allowance.
_approve writes allowance entries and forcibly zeroes them for non-owner approvers.
_approve branches on comparing the approver against the owner() state variable.
The non-owner path in _approve triggers the unilateral allowance-zeroing operation.
The reset operation writes a zero value into the _allowances mapping.
Parameter 'ol' is the allowance owner used inside _approve.
Parameter 'tt' is the allowance spender used inside _approve.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping to return the stored value.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping for the queried account.
totalSupply() returns the _tTotal state variable.
Parameter 'account' is the lookup key for balanceOf.
approve delegates its logic to the private _approve routine.
Parameter 'newOwner' is the value assigned to the privileged _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the new privileged address into _owner.
_functionCallWithValue executes an arbitrary low-level external call with value and data, allowing the callee to reenter.
sendValue performs a value-forwarding low-level call to an arbitrary recipient, which can invoke back into the contract.
The external low-level call executes before dependent state is finalized, so the callee can reenter balance-mutating logic such as _transfer.
SafeMath.add stores its checked sum in the local variable c.
The checked sum c is written back as the recipient's new balance in _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'sender' parameter exists only to key the balance debit inside _transfer and has no independent meaning.
The 'recipient' parameter exists only to key the balance credit inside _transfer.
The 'amount' parameter is the transferred quantity consumed by _transfer's SafeMath operations.
The 'spender' parameter of approve is forwarded directly into _approve and carries no separate semantics.
The 'ol' parameter is the allowance owner key handled entirely inside _approve.
The 'tt' parameter is the allowance spender key handled entirely inside _approve.
The 'account' parameter is only used as the balanceOf lookup key.
The 'newOwner' parameter is only meaningful as the value written to _owner by transferOwnership.
The local temporary c exists only to hold the SafeMath.add result before it is assigned to a balance.
